title: cf-tools-replay-viewer debrief markdown section index
description: M14 audit pass 3 (GAP-M10-03): JSON sidecar of `cfctl replay debrief <bundle>`. Lists every `##` section heading emitted by `render_markdown` in declaration order, with their starting byte offsets for AI Self-Test grading + spec-literal assertions.

heading.description: Section name without the leading `## ` prefix.

level.description: Markdown header level (2 for `##`, 3 for `###`, etc.).

is_stub.description: True when the section ships only a stub header pending later-milestone producer events.
